scope: AC1018 TABLE shared-border virtual-edge ownership and canonical writer/parser behavior
specification: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 §20.4.96.1, Until R21

rules: a virtual edge is present in the cell edge mask and has an adjacent cell
the adjacent cell carries the reciprocal edge mask without marking that edge virtual
the border property override is stored on the non-virtual adjacent edge only
the virtual cell carries no duplicate border-property mask for that edge
invalid, boundary, one-sided, or duplicate virtual relationships are semantically incomplete on read and refused on write
implementation.wire: The writer emits the virtual-edge byte when needed, including when it is the only cell override record; parsed range accounting includes that record.

validation.result: 1/1 focused test passed. A generated two-cell AC1018 table stores a right edge once on the neighbor and marks the adjacent cell's right edge virtual; typed parseback preserves both edge masks, the virtual byte, border color, and following-body sentinel. A one-bit mutation that creates an out-of-bounds virtual edge remains readable but semantically incomplete. A duplicate override on the virtual edge refuses without changing body/handle destinations and the corrected same-object retry succeeds.

limits: The drawing was authored locally for this control; no physical producer sample was added.
This does not qualify producer ordering, AutoCAD/ODA acceptance, native TABLE rendering, or broad TABLE support.
No DXF shared-border semantic promotion is implied.
